text: Hello boys and girls, I'm Ms.Wu from Baoshan No.2 Central Primary School, I'm so glad to see you.Now, let's begin our English class.First, let's learn the sounds.Now, please read after me.Now, let's enjoy a rhyme.This rhyme is about the four seasons.They are spring, summer, autumn, and winter.Look, Ms.Fang and the children are talking about their favorite seasons.What season does Peter like?What season does Alice like?What about Kitty and Danny?Let's watch a video and take.I like riding my bicycle in the park.I like summer.Summer is sunny and hot.I like swimming in the water.I like autumn.Autumn is windy and cool.I like flying a kite in the park.I like winter.Winter is cloudy and cold.I like skating on the ice.He likes autumn.Does Alice like autumn?No, she likes winter.What about Kitty?I like spring.She likes spring.And Danny likes?Summer.We know Peter likes autumn.Look, autumn, autumn.Look at my mouth, autumn.Close your mouth.Follow me, autumn.Let's spell together.Autumn, autumn, a-u-t-u-m-n, autumn.How is the weather in autumn?Listen to the wind.Autumn is windy.So is autumn warm, hot, cool or cold?That's right, autumn is cool.Look, Peter feels cool in autumn.Cool, o-o-u, cool.Let's spell, cool, cool, c-o-o-l, cool.Read after me, cool.Autumn is windy, autumn is cool.So autumn is windy and cool.Follow me, autumn is windy and cool.Here's a chant about autumn, boys and girls.First, listen.Can you try?Let's read together.Autumn, autumn, windy and cool.Autumn, autumn, I like autumn.Peter, what do you like doing in autumn?Peter says, I like.which one?A or B?That's right, I like flying a kite in the park.Follow me, I like flying a kite in the park.Now, listen to Peter.I like autumn, autumn is windy and cool.Now, you try.What else do you like doing in autumn, boys and girls?Do you like running, skipping a rope, or maybe playing football?Can you tell me?Oh, that sounds interesting.Peter likes autumn.What about Alice?She likes winter.Look, winter, winter.Let's spell, winter, winter.Winter, winter, w-i-n-t-e-r, winter.Follow me, winter.How is the weather in winter?Is it cool in winter?No, winter is cold, o-o, cold.Let's spell, cold, cold.c-o-l-d, cold.You try.Winter is cold, winter is cloudy.So, winter is cloudy and cold, cloudy and cold.Read after me, winter is cloudy and cold.We've learnt chants about autumn, boys and girls.Can you make a new chant about winter?Have a try.Here's my chant.Winter, winter, I like winter.Good job.What does Alice like doing in winter, A or B?Right, she likes skating on the ice.She can skate on the ice.Pay attention.在这里,T-H-E 的发音,D, on the ice.Follow me, skate on the ice.Now, let's watch a video about skating on the ice.In winter, it's very cold.Many people like skating on the ice.This is Beijing.Look, he can skate very well.冬天,很多地方非常寒冷。湖面接了冰,人们就喜欢在冰面上滑冰。你看,多么有趣啊。Alice says, I like skating on the ice.We delete E, add I and G.She says, I like skating on the ice.Now you read.Now you will favorite seasons.What about you?What's your favorite season?Boys and girls, you can use the words and phrases in the box.Please think and say.Now, Ms.Fang knows about the children's favorite season.Do
